first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The adult man on the image-left side of the foreground, with side-parted brown hair and a thin mustache, wearing a dark purple jacket with red piping, a white shirt, and a black bow tie, and holding a note.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The young man behind and to the image-right of Person A, wearing a dark purple stand-collar uniform and a matching brimless cylindrical hat with two lines of gold lettering.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The red carpet area at the bottom of the image; in the latter part, its red main area and orange-brown and dark red border bands are visible.

entities.name: ivory-white double doors
entities.identification: The double doors in the background that appear cream-colored under warm light, with light-colored translucent panels, an arched door surround, and a pair of vertical handles.

entities.name: cream-pink wall
entities.identification: The light warm-pink wall behind the people, with rectangular molding divisions and a light-colored doorframe.

entities.name: group of wall-mounted light fixtures
entities.identification: The illuminated group of wall-mounted light fixtures on the background wall, in which elongated vertical white shades and darker upper connectors can be distinguished.

entities.name: wood-framed upholstered chair in the lobby
entities.identification: The group of seats beside the background passage, with brown upholstery, light brown wooden frames, chair backs, and armrests.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The group of background people other than the main people; the clearest member in this clip is the seated balding man in a gray jacket at the rear on the image-right.

entities.name: geometric-patterned floor
entities.identification: The light-colored floor with repeating brown geometric patterns visible in front of the doors and between the red carpet areas.

entities.name: note
entities.identification: The white rectangular note held by Person A, in front of the lower part of Person A's body.
